HomePage.description: Looking for a starting point or more instructions? Head over to <templates>Templates</templates> or the <learning>Learning</learning> center.

IntroPage.title: Operational intelligence for MODON's industrial cities
IntroPage.subtitle: A unified view of the industrial base across MODON — factories, sectors, and infrastructure — turned into clear, decision-ready insight.

industries.title: Industry analysis
industries.description: See the leading and smallest manufacturing sectors ranked by factories, share, and city coverage.

cities.title: Industrial cities
cities.description: Understand how activity is distributed across MODON's industrial cities and zones.

network.title: Infrastructure
network.description: Track the supporting utility and services network that keeps the industrial base running.

demand.title: Demand analysis
demand.description: Track customs trade demand into MODON cities — import weight, origins, product chapters, and monthly trends.

DemandPage.title: Demand analysis
DemandPage.subtitle: Customs declarations linked to MODON industrial cities — trade weight as the primary signal of input demand and output flow across the network.

IndustriesPage.title: Industries in MODON
IndustriesPage.subtitle: A snapshot of the industrial base across MODON cities, ranked by the number of factories in each manufacturing sector.
IndustriesPage.sourceNote: Source: MODON GIS parcel layer (105) and utility network (77). Ranking covers standard manufacturing sectors.

MapPage.title: Industrial cities map
MapPage.subtitle: Explore MODON's industrial cities across the Kingdom — click a marker to see factory counts at each location.
MapPage.tokenMissing: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN to .env.local to enable the map.
MapPage.sourceNote: City locations are approximate. Factory counts shown on markers are illustrative until live GIS data is connected.
